subject: Strategic Plan Community Engagement Strategy
overview: The subcommittee met to design a community engagement process intended to redefine the district's mission statement and set five-year priorities. The group reviewed draft materials for public surveys and focus groups to ensure broad participation from residents, staff, and students.

items.title: Phase One Strategic Planning Framework
items.summary: The subcommittee chair outlined a two-phase approach starting with community input to establish a district vision followed by an administrative action plan.

items.title: Stakeholder Outreach and Listening Sessions
items.summary: Superintendent Galusi discussed past listening sessions and the need to engage underrepresented groups, including non-parent caregivers and families not currently enrolled in the district.

items.title: Public Survey Development
items.summary: Members reviewed and edited draft survey questions focusing on district priorities, mission statement resonance, and demographic tracking to ensure data accurately reflects Medford's population.

items.title: Focus Group Structure and Facilitation
items.summary: The subcommittee discussed a draft agenda for two-hour interactive community workshops involving sticky-note brainstorming and small-group discussions on specific educational topics.

items.title: Project Timeline and High School Coordination
items.summary: Members discussed aligning the strategic planning schedule with the Massachusetts School Building Authority feasibility study for the new high school to avoid community engagement fatigue.

items.title: Reporting and Next Steps
items.summary: The subcommittee approved a motion to present the refined survey and focus group drafts to the School Committee on October 20.
